$schema.description: Location of this schema for editor support.

hostKeyFile.description: PEM SSH host key used by the server.

bindAddress.description: Address to bind the listener to. Omit to listen on all IPv4 and IPv6 interfaces.

uploadStagingDir.description: Private directory used while SFTP uploads are in progress.

loginGraceMs.description: Milliseconds a connection may take to authenticate before it is disconnected, as in sshd_config LoginGraceTime. 0 means no limit.

baseURL.description: Base URL for the multi-step authentication API.

url.description: Single endpoint for password authentication and filesystem setup.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds one HTTP request to the authentication backend may take. 0 means no limit.

fileBackend.description: Consent to serve local files. Without this property no file:// backend URL can be reached, whether it is configured or returned by a backend listing.

allowedPrefixes.description: Absolute, cleaned directories that may be served. Nothing outside them is reachable, and no prefix may contain another. Each must exist at startup.

clientAliveMs.description: Milliseconds an authenticated session may go unanswered before the server probes the client, as in sshd_config ClientAliveInterval. 0 disables probing.

clientAliveCountMax.description: Consecutive unanswered probes that end the connection, as in sshd_config ClientAliveCountMax. 0 never terminates on a missed probe.

maxConcurrentUploads.description: Uploads this user's SFTP connection may have open at once. 0 means no limit.

rootfs.description: The root directory node. Like any directory it may have a backend, its own allowedMethods, or statically configured children; a backend is what makes the root itself listable and writable.

maxUploadSize.description: Maximum bytes written to a directly created file. 0 means no limit.

mtime.description: Optional RFC 3339 modification time presented to SFTP clients.

maxUploadSize.description: Maximum bytes written to this file, or to a directly created child of this directory. 0 means no limit.

backend.description: Where this node is served from: an http:// or https:// base URL, or a file:// URL naming an absolute local path beneath a fileBackend.allowedPrefixes entry.

permissions.description: POSIX permission bits presented to SFTP clients. On a file:// node they are also enforced, as a mask over the permissions the filesystem itself reports: a read bit permits reading and listing, a write bit permits every change, and the mask is inherited by everything beneath the node. A mask can only take permission away.

allowedMethods.description: HTTP methods the proxy may send to this node's backend. Applies to that node alone and is never inherited by or from another. Requires an http:// or https:// backend, since it constrains requests to one; on a file:// node use permissions instead. An omitted value allows all supported methods.
